text: 🍿 Hogwarts shows up in Harry's glasses on HBO's new poster HBO's new poster for its Harry Potter series puts the castle in the reflection of Harry's round lenses, as /Film reports . It's the first official look at Hogwarts in the show, and it's a sliver. The framing puts Harry first and the castle second. Chris Columbus opened his films with sweeping establishing shots, and Alfonso Cuarón made the place moodier and lived-in. A reflection is a safe, smart first tease. The real test is whether the full castle looks built or rendered.

🎬 HBO's 'Harry Potter' gives James and Lily real faces, and adds a Weasley the films skipped Season 1 premieres Dec. 25, and Jasper Talbot and Hannah Chinn will play James and Lily Potter. Harry Gilby is Charlie Weasley, a book character who never appeared in the films. In the movies the Potters were photographs, flashbacks and a Mirror of Erised cameo. Casting two actors suggests Francesca Gardiner has room for them to do more than haunt Harry. Charlie is a small role, but it shows the show plans to use the books' full cast. That's the real advantage of ten hours a season.
